BCCI assures Asia Cup trophies will return to India

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has assured that both trophies from the Asia Cup will be brought back to India. BCCI Secretary Devjit Saikia stated that while a specific timeline for their return is not yet set, the trophies will indeed come to India. This assurance follows reports of the trophies being with Pakistan Cricket Board officials, including Mohsin Naqvi, and a mention that BCCI Secretary Saikia had indicated a 15-day period for their return.
